openPRs.title: refactor(event-post-sync): unify Event→Post sync trigger behind EventPostSyncScheduler
openPRs.author: feng-1m
openPRs.body:
## Problem

The Event→Post sync had **3 accreted publish paths** with inconsistent freshness guarantees:

1. **`withEventSync`** — used a closure-captured entity (stale after `batchOperate` lineup changes) → caused the #8376 lineup bug
2. **product-v2 strategy hooks** — called `triggerEventPostSync` directly, bypassing the unified path
3. **`update()` service method** — applied snapshot masking that hid tax-recalc price changes and missed products-added-to-sync-disabled events; duplicate-service

openPRs.author: junetengext-a11y
openPRs.body:
## Summary

新增 admin-facing REST 端点用于 feature-setting 管理，POST/PUT 后触发主动缓存失效。

将公开设置的缓存策略从纯 TTL（5min）升级为 Cache-Aside + 主动失效（Level 5），解决 admin-server 通过 RPC 修改数据后 consumer 端缓存延迟问题。

## New Endpoints

```
GET    /admin/feature-setting           → 列表（返回 featureName/featureData/enable）
GET    /admin/feature-setting/:name     → 单条查询
POST   /admin/feature-setting           → 创建 + 缓存失效
PUT    /admin/feature-setting/:name     → 更新（enable 可选）+ 缓存失效
```
